scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace=@exporta/domain && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace=@exporta/api" "npm run dev --workspace=@exporta/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@exporta/domain && npm run build --workspace=@exporta/api && npm run build --workspace=@exporta/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@exporta/domain && npm run typecheck --workspace=@exporta/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=@exporta/web
